edits.old: | Contract dependencies | RWB-P6-E2022-CON; RWB-P4-E1037-CON (serves the operations in section 12.1) |
edits.new: | Contract dependencies | RWB-P6-E2022-CON; RWB-P4-E1037-CON (serves the operations in section 12.1); RWB-P1-E1066-CON (contact-point and ledger operations, open under GAP-1070) |

edits.old: The letters per role are carried from the legacy story and are not in the TSD P4 matrix (GAP-0953; ASM-1684).
edits.new: The letters per role are carried from the legacy story and are added to the TSD P4 matrix and loaded as `PM-2026.12` rows, so no story holds a letter of its own (GAP-0953; ASM-1684).

disposition.target: rwb-decision: conduct and consent rule package
disposition.change: Publish the first version of one versioned conduct and consent rule package, approved by the conduct and QA officer, so the story can name its identifier.
disposition.note: No rule package or requirement ID for the conduct and consent sets exists in the sources; the package must be created first.
Masking label, covered field IDs, AC-READ granularity and parameter defaults are not in the sources; they settle at the wave-2 policy load, so no value is invented.

disposition.change: Name the contact-point read, consent and verified fields, failed-count update, and ledger record and delivery-update operations. Dependency row now lists RWB-P1-E1066-CON.
disposition.note: P1 contract added to Contract dependencies; operation names remain open under the gap until P1 publishes them.

disposition.target: TSD P6 T6.1 and gateway-bff composite route
disposition.change: Add a Case record row for the T6.1 area and declare Case record right C on the gateway-bff composite route answering MSG-P4-002 and MSG-P4-003.
disposition.note: DP-08 is not in the pattern set, so the guard is local to rwb-comms until the composite route declares the Case record check.

disposition.change: Expose the contact point, its consent state and failed count for read, and a verification and consent change for write, through the rwb-source-data contract. Enforcement stays in rwb-comms.
disposition.note: Consent data sits in rwb-source-data's extension table; rwb-comms reads and writes it through the contract.
NSS and LINE OA test doubles, harness pack, seeding and gate are not in the sources; they need agreement with the ACE notification team and QA.

disposition.change: Add the Case record column and the other decided capability areas to the matrix before the first SIT entry, and load the letters as PM-2026.12 rows.
disposition.note: The story now states the letters are loaded as PM-2026.12 rows and no longer holds a letter of its own.

disposition.change: Publish the request shape, accepted-reference format, NSS and LINE OA result-code maps and callback path before the wave 2 SIT entry.
disposition.note: Contract not in the sources; RWB-P6-E2022-APP uses the section 12.8 stub until the ACE path owner publishes it.

disposition.target: Architecture v5 slide 44 and the platform relay owner
disposition.change: Confirm that the attempt counter and rule R-UNI-34 count one send attempt per relay window, with the path's internal retries excluded.
disposition.note: The relay owner must confirm the window semantics; the story's retry-limit reading is pending that confirmation.

disposition.change: State the result transport for NSS and LINE OA. rwb-comms accepts a callback or a poll for a known external reference; a result for an unknown reference is not applied.
disposition.note: No transport is named in the sources; the path owner must state it so rwb-comms can accept the LINE OA read status.
